queries.name: columnas_identidad_productos
queries.sql:
SELECT
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS columna,
    t.name AS tipo_sql,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.columns c
JOIN sys.tables tb ON tb.object_id = c.object_id
JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE tb.name = 'Sync_Productos'
ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: columnas_identidad_insumos_recetas
queries.sql:
SELECT
    tb.name AS tabla,
    c.name AS columna,
    t.name AS tipo_sql,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables tb
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = tb.object_id
JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE tb.name IN (
    'Sync_Productos_Insumos',
    'Sync_Productos_Recetas'
)
ORDER BY tb.name, c.column_id

queries.name: tablas_relacion_empresas
queries.sql:
SELECT
    tb.name AS tabla,
    c.name AS columna,
    t.name AS tipo_sql
FROM sys.tables tb
JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = tb.object_id
JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE (
    c.name LIKE '%Empresa%'
    OR c.name LIKE '%Sucursal%'
    OR c.name LIKE '%UnidadNegocio%'
    OR c.name LIKE '%ServerID%'
)
AND (
    tb.name LIKE '%Producto%'
    OR tb.name LIKE '%Receta%'
    OR tb.name LIKE '%Insumo%'
    OR tb.name LIKE '%Empresa%'
    OR tb.name LIKE '%Unidad%'
    OR tb.name LIKE '%Sync%'
)
ORDER BY tb.name, c.name

queries.name: relaciones_fk_existentes
queries.sql:
SELECT
    fk.name AS foreign_key,
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS tabla_origen,
    pc.name AS columna_origen,
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS tabla_destino,
    rc.name AS columna_destino
FROM sys.foreign_keys fk
JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
    ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.columns pc
    ON pc.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id
    AND pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
JOIN sys.columns rc
    ON rc.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id
    AND rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (
    'Sync_Productos',
    'Sync_Productos_Insumos',
    'Sync_Productos_Recetas',
    'Unidades_Negocio',
    'Sistema_Empresas'
)
ORDER BY tabla_origen, foreign_key

queries.name: servidores_y_unidades
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36),
        TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id)
    ) AS ServerID,
    COUNT(*) AS unidades,
    STRING_AGG(
        CONVERT(nvarchar(max), u.codigo),
        ', '
    ) AS codigos
FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u
WHERE u.activo = 1
GROUP BY TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id)
ORDER BY unidades DESC

queries.name: distribucion_productos_servidor
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), p.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS productos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductoID) AS producto_ids_distintos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.EmpresaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS empresa_id_null,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.UnidadNegocioID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS unidad_id_null
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos p
GROUP BY p.ServerID
ORDER BY productos DESC

objective: Identificar relaciones canonicas entre productos, empresas, unidades, servidores, insumos y recetas. Auditoria exclusivamente READ_ONLY de metadatos y distribucion de identificadores. Sin cambios.
